capabilities: Hold notes as cards in a sidebar pane
Add headings or blocks as cards
extras: Moving tabs onto the desk relies on parts of Obsidian outside its plugin API and may break after an Obsidian update; drag and drop needs a mouse or trackpad and does nothing on touch screens; only Markdown notes can be placed on the desk; syncing requires enabling Installed community plugins, which syncs every community plugin, not just this one.
problem: Switching between reference notes and the note being written clutters the editor with tabs and pulls focus away from the current note.

relations.evidence: With Obsidian Sync, the desk can follow you from one device to the next.

summary: A sidebar pane that temporarily holds notes, headings, and blocks as cards while you focus on writing your current note.
